required_gates.semantics: Names, documentation, IO and actual behavior agree; label corrected CPU reconstruction accurately.
required_gates.review: Structural, semantic, runtime and developer-semantics statuses pass, or receive explicitly documented conditional passes.
required_gates.metadata: Valid IO/parameter specs, low-jargon descriptions and file-backed metadata that backfills cleanly.
required_gates.provenance: Valid registry references and correct applicable code anchors.
required_gates.behavior: Representative execution, edge cases and material limitations supported by tests/evidence.
required_gates.duplication: Check proposed atoms against existing catalog atoms before publication.

tier_one_only: Human expert certification, insured guarantees and recursive Tier 1 dependency certification.
conditional_scope_candidates: Explicit CPU and diagnostic batch/worker settings; no original TPU or leaderboard equivalence claim.
Caller-supplied prepared records with validated identity alignment; historical record generation not reconstructed.
Official CropNet reference with cached-copy identity unverified.
remaining_concrete_work: Finish actual combined execution and inspect its evidence.
Create provider atoms and CDG metadata/contracts, perform duplication and semantic review.
Complete required attribution and model-reference terms review; use documented limits rather than unsupported claims.
Run transactional publication gates, approve Tier 3 rows and verify served graph execution.
not_automatic_tier_three_blockers: Lack of original hardware or leaderboard-score reproduction when not claimed.
Lack of a fresh environment installation, if the actual reviewed runtime and its limitations are sufficiently evidenced.
